info.name: Noun Project API V2 Autocomplete Collection API

params.name: query
params.description: Search term used to match collection titles, tags, and descriptions.

params.name: blacklist
params.description: When true, applies the client's configured blocklist to results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of collections returned per page.

params.name: prev_page
params.description: Cursor token returned by a prior response for backward pagination.

params.name: next_page
params.description: Cursor token returned by a prior response for forward pagination.

items.docs: Search curated icon collections (icon sets) by query term. Returns a paginated list of matching collections with metadata.

params.name: blacklist
params.description: When true, returns 404 if the collection is on the client's blocklist.

params.name: thumbnail_size
params.description: Pixel dimension for returned thumbnail URLs.

params.name: include_svg
params.description: When true, includes raw SVG markup in each member icon.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of member icons returned per page.

params.name: prev_page
params.description: Cursor token returned by a prior response for backward pagination.

params.name: next_page
params.description: Cursor token returned by a prior response for forward pagination.

items.docs: Retrieve a single icon collection with full metadata and member icons.
